forward: Explicit coordinate/FP32-time control on the same saved students, under no_grad; see per-axis numeric definition. New AEE required, not training-final bit equivalence.
storage: Copy NPZ values into original training strides, including Conv2 V stride32 and live sourceA/d/P parameterization; preserve frozen parent and base projection bias plus separate delta.

coordinate_function.completed_state: signed24 f14; RNE then saturate at every matrix completion and residual merge
coordinate_function.coefficient_format: Each complete static matrix signed16 with exponent floor(log2(32767/maxabs)); zero matrix exponent0. RNE, no near-zero threshold.
coordinate_function.in_flight: signed48 integers in Float64; proven whole-domain absolute sum below2^47, hence products/partial sums exact regardless of GEMM summation order. Not RTL.

source.scope: Exact rational binary saved constants; inclusive ceil/floor. Constant rows follow exact gain/domain logic, not a small-gain cutoff.

consumer.scope: Exact rational binary saved constants; inclusive ceil/floor. Constant rows follow exact gain/domain logic, not a small-gain cutoff.

coordinate_function.compile_numeric: Live FP32 factors/BN constants promoted to Float64 for gain/F/offset compilation; quantized As is inverted in Float64 and independently quantized16.
coordinate_function.updates: Only even/even anchors receive residual and BN2 constant; nonanchor whole BN branch deletion is preserved.
coordinate_function.state_order: I24 -> As -> Q24 -> source gate (Q discarded); Z24 -> F -> residual24; I24+residual24+constant -> X24; U -> latent24 -> V -> output24 -> bias merge24
coordinate_function.consumer_execution: Actual saved signed gain is compiled into inclusive >=ceil / <=floor thresholds; no runtime d/e multiplication; exactly zero gain is a constant gate
coordinate_function.shadow: Original FP Conv2, outer BN2 and identity add still run for software call/shape compatibility. Both PED consumers ignore their float input and use only cached integer coordinates. Shadow GPU work is not hardware workload.
coordinate_function.outside_scope: Frozen preview Conv1/sn2 and the rest of the network keep their original numeric function. Source/consumer emit their own actual theta*g, not unit gates.
coordinate_function.claim: One fixed-format new numeric function; fresh AEE/activity required. No full-network integer, native-equivalence, memory-removal, power or cycle claim.

evaluation.claim: Dense function/accuracy check; elapsed time is not a speed comparison

training_final_alignment.scope: New coordinate/FP32-time function versus old training-final arithmetic; differences are expected, not an exact reload failure.
